findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: Inspector observed a hole in the wall behind the mop sink. Discussed with PIC. PIC stated they would put in a work order with the county office as soon as possible. Ensure all holes are sealed to allow for smooth and easily cleanable surfaces.
findings.citation_text: 6-101.11(A)(1) Surface Characteristics. (A) Except as specified in (B) of this section, materials for indoor floor, wall, and ceiling surfaces under conditions of normal use shall be: (1) SMOOTH, durable, and EASILY CLEANABLE for areas where FOOD ESTABLISHMENT operations are conducted.

findings.title: Food separated and protected
findings.comment:
Inspector observed a box of ramen noodles being stored next to cleaning supplies. Educated PIC on proper separation and protection of food. PIC moved the box in to dry storage. Ensure food is kept away from potential hazardous materials.

3-302.11: (A) (1)-(2) FOOD shall be protected from cross contamination during storage, preparation, holding, and display (P).

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
Observed a mop being stored in the mop bucket.  Discussed with PIC, COS. Ensure mops are hung or placed in a position to properly air dry to prevent mold growth.

6-501.16: After use, mops shall be placed in a position that allows them to airdry without soiling walls, EQUIPMENT, or supplies.
